inclusion_rule: Decoders of speech-related or neural signals (any modality: EEG, intracranial, EMG, ultrasound, video) that update model weights or normalization state from unlabeled test data at use time (self-supervised test-time training, entropy minimization such as Tent, pseudo-label self-training, source-free adaptation).
